gloss: actually; really; in fact; as proof

definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize that something is true or exists in reality.
Used to introduce concrete evidence supporting a claim.

examples.japanese: {現|げん}に、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In fact, he is an eyewitness to that incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{現|げん}に⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: You say that won't happen, but it's actually happening.
I actually saw it with my own eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦という→という：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{現|げん}に⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: They say the economy is recovering, but in reality, salaries haven't gone up.
It was said to be safe, but an accident actually happened.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。{現|げん}に、⟦{飲|の}み{始|はじ}めて→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: That medicine is effective. As proof, my symptoms improved after I started taking it.

notes:
{現|げん}に is an adverb used to emphasize the reality or actuality of something, often when countering doubt or providing evidence.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現|げん}に～⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is actually doing ~)
- {現|げん}に⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (actually exists)
- {現|げん}に⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is actually happening)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現|げん}に vs. ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is more general ("actually, in practice"); {現|げん}に emphasizes concrete evidence or current reality.
- {現|げん}に vs. ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧: ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧ is more emotional ("truly, really"); {現|げん}に is more objective and evidentiary.

USAGE:
{現|げん}に is often used when presenting evidence to counter skepticism or to emphasize that something that might seem unlikely is in fact true.

Register: Neutral to slightly formal. Common in writing and formal speech.
